description.para: The 5 constants are the prefixes or suffixes for merge on read configuration.

The complete configuration keys can be:
fields.$field_name.aggregate-function
fields.$field_name.ignore-retract
fields.$field_names.sequence-group ($field_names support one or more field_name, split with FIELDS_SEPARATOR)

briefdescription.para: FIELDS_SEPARATOR is ",".
FIELDS_PREFIX is "fields".
AGG_FUNCTION is "aggregate-function".
DEFAULT_AGG_FUNCTION is "default-aggregate-function".
IGNORE_RETRACT is "ignore-retract".
NESTED_KEY is "nested-key".
NESTED_KEY_NULL_STRATEGY is "nested-key-null-strategy".
NESTED_SEQUENCE_FIELD is "nested-sequence-field".
COUNT_LIMIT is "count-limit".
"distinct" - Distinct option for aggregate functions like listagg.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is false. Example: fields.f.distinct=true to deduplicate values during aggregation.

briefdescription.para: "list-agg-delimiter" - Delimiter for listagg aggregate function.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is ",". Example: fields.f.list-agg-delimiter="-" to concatenate values with "-".

briefdescription.para: SEQUENCE_GROUP is "sequence-group".
"bucket" - Bucket mode or bucket count for file store.

detaileddescription.para: Append tables support -1 (unaware-bucket mode), primary-key tables support -2 (postpone-bucket mode), and both table types support values greater than 0 (fixed-bucket mode).

briefdescription.para: "bucket-key" - Specify the paimon distribution policy.

detaileddescription.para: Data is assigned to each bucket according to the hash value of bucket-key. If you specify multiple fields, delimiter is ','. If not specified, the primary key will be used, if there is no primary key, the full row will be used.

briefdescription.para: "page-size" - Memory page size, default value 64 kb.
"file.format" - Specify the message format of data files.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is parquet.

briefdescription.para: "file-system" - Specify the file system.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is local.

briefdescription.para: "target-file-size" - Target size of a file.

detaileddescription.para: primary key table: the default value is 128 MB. append table: the default value is 256 MB.

briefdescription.para: "target-file-row-num" - Target number of rows per newly written data file.

detaileddescription.para: Disabled by default. A file rolls when this or target-file-size is reached, whichever comes first. This limit is enforced at write-batch granularity, so a file may exceed the target by up to one batch.

briefdescription.para: "blob.target-file-size" - Target size of a blob file. Default is TARGET_FILE_SIZE.
"blob.split-by-file-size" - Whether to consider blob file size as a factor when performing scan splitting.

detaileddescription.para: When unset, defaults to the negation of BLOB_AS_DESCRIPTOR.

briefdescription.para: "partition.default-name" - The default partition name in case the dynamic partition column value is null/empty string.

detaileddescription.para: Default is "__DEFAULT_PARTITION__".

briefdescription.para: "file.compression" - The default file compression is zstd.

detaileddescription.para: For faster read and write, it is recommended to use zstd.

briefdescription.para: "file.compression.zstd-level" Default file compression zstd level.

detaileddescription.para: For higher compression rates, it can be configured to 9, but the read and write speed will significantly decrease. Default value is 1.

briefdescription.para: "file.block-size" - File block size of format, default value of orc stripe is 64 MB, parquet row group is 128 MB, and Mosaic row group is 256 MB.
"manifest.target-file-size" - Suggested file size of a manifest file.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 8MB.

briefdescription.para: "manifest.compression" - File compression for manifest, default value is zstd.
"manifest.merge-min-count" - To avoid frequent manifest merges, this parameter specifies the minimum number of ManifestFileMeta to merge, default value is 30.
"manifest.full-compaction-threshold-size" - The size threshold for triggering full compaction of manifest, default value is 16MB.
"manifest.delete-file-drop-stats" - Whether final DELETE manifest entries should omit value statistics.

detaileddescription.para: Default is false only for compatibility with old readers.

briefdescription.para: "source.split.target-size" - Target size of a source split when scanning a bucket.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 128MB.

briefdescription.para: "source.split.open-file-cost" - Open file cost of a source file.

detaileddescription.para: It is used to avoid reading too many files with a source split, which can be very slow. Default value is 4MB.

briefdescription.para: "scan.snapshot-id" - Optional snapshot id used in case of "from-snapshot" or "from-snapshot-full" scan mode
"scan.mode" - Specify the scanning behavior of the source.

detaileddescription.para: Values can be: "default", "latest-full", "latest", "from-snapshot", "from-snapshot-full". Default value is "default".

briefdescription.para: "scan.manifest-entry-cache.max-snapshots" - Maximum number of snapshot live manifest entry results retained per table, branch, and bucket.

detaileddescription.para: Setting it to 0 disables manifest entry cache. Default value is 0.

briefdescription.para: "scan.manifest-entry.lazy-decode.enabled" - Whether to deserialize only manifest entries for the target bucket when rebuilding the cache.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is true.

briefdescription.para: "prefetch.io-metrics.enabled" - Whether to collect per-I/O metrics for prefetch reads.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is false.

briefdescription.para: "read.batch-size" - Read batch size for any file format if it supports.

detaileddescription.para: The default value is 1024.

briefdescription.para: "write.batch-size" - Write batch size for any file format if it supports.

detaileddescription.para: The default value is 1024.

briefdescription.para: "write-buffer-size" - Amount of data to build up in memory before converting to a sorted on-disk file.

detaileddescription.para: The default value is 256 mb

briefdescription.para: "write-buffer-spillable" - Whether the write buffer can be spillable. Default value is true.
"write-buffer-spill.max-disk-size" - The max disk to use for write buffer spill.

detaileddescription.para: This only works when the write buffer spill is enabled. Default value is unlimited.

briefdescription.para: "local-sort.max-num-file-handles" - The maximal fan-in for external merge sort.

detaileddescription.para: It limits the number of file handles. If it is too small, may cause intermediate merging. But if it is too large, it will cause too many files opened at the same time, consume memory and lead to random reading. Default value is 128.

briefdescription.para: "spill-compression" - Compression for spill. Default value is zstd.
"spill-compression.zstd-level" - Default spill compression zstd level.

detaileddescription.para: For higher compression rates, it can be configured to 9, but the read and write speed will significantly decrease. Default value is 1.

briefdescription.para: "snapshot.num-retained.min" - The minimum number of completed snapshots to retain.

detaileddescription.para: Should be greater than or equal to 1. Default value is 10

briefdescription.para: "snapshot.num-retained.max" - The maximum number of completed snapshots to retain.

detaileddescription.para: Should be greater than or equal to the minimum number. Default value is int32 max value.

briefdescription.para: "snapshot.time-retained" - The maximum time of completed snapshots to retain.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 1 hour.

briefdescription.para: "snapshot.expire.limit" - The maximum number of snapshots allowed to expire at a time.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 50.

briefdescription.para: "snapshot.clean-empty-directories" - Whether to try to clean empty directories when expiring snapshots, if enabled, please note: hdfs: may print exceptions in NameNode.

detaileddescription.para: oss/s3: may cause performance issue. Default value is false.

briefdescription.para: "commit.force-compact" - Whether to force a compaction before commit.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "commit.timeout" - Timeout duration of retry when commit failed. No default value.
"commit.max-retries" - Maximum number of retries when commit failed. Default value is 10.
"commit.min-retry-wait" - Min retry wait time when commit failed. Default value is 10ms.
"commit.max-retry-wait" - Max retry wait time when commit failed. Default value is 10s.
"commit.discard-duplicate-files" - Whether to discard duplicate files in commit.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "compaction.max-size-amplification-percent" - The size amplification is defined as the amount (in percentage) of additional storage needed to store a single byte of data in the merge tree for changelog mode table.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 200.

briefdescription.para: "compaction.size-ratio" - Percentage flexibility while comparing sorted run size for changelog mode table.

detaileddescription.para: If the candidate sorted run(s) size is 1% smaller than the next sorted run's size, then include next sorted run into this candidate set. Default value is 1.

briefdescription.para: "num-sorted-run.compaction-trigger" - The sorted run number to trigger compaction.

detaileddescription.para: Includes level0 files (one file one sorted run) and high-level runs (one level one sorted run). Default value is 5.

briefdescription.para: "num-sorted-run.stop-trigger" - The number of sorted runs that trigger the stopping of writes, the default value is 'num-sorted-run.compaction-trigger' + 3.
"num-levels" - Total level number, for example, there are 3 levels, including 0,1,2 levels.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "lookup-wait" - When need to lookup, commit will wait for compaction by lookup.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "true".

briefdescription.para: "lookup-compact" - Lookup compact mode used for lookup compaction.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is LookupCompactMode::RADICAL.

briefdescription.para: "compaction.force-up-level-0" - If set to true, compaction strategy will always include all level 0 files in candidates.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is false.

briefdescription.para: "overwrite-upgrade" - Whether to try upgrading the data files after overwriting a primary key table.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is true.

briefdescription.para: "dynamic-partition-overwrite" - Whether only overwrite dynamic partition when overwriting a partitioned table with dynamic partition columns.

detaileddescription.para: Works only when the table has partition keys. Default value is true.

briefdescription.para: "lookup-compact.max-interval" - The max interval for a gentle mode lookup compaction to be triggered.

detaileddescription.para: For every interval, a forced lookup compaction will be performed to flush L0 files to higher level. This option is only valid when lookup-compact mode is gentle. No default value.

briefdescription.para: "sequence.field" - The field that generates the sequence number for primary key table, the sequence number determines which data is the most recent.

detaileddescription.para: Value use "," as delimiter.

briefdescription.para: "sequence.field.sort-order" - Specify the order of sequence.field.

detaileddescription.para: Values can be: "ascending", "descending". Default value is "ascending".

briefdescription.para: "merge-engine" - Specify the merge engine for table with primary key.

detaileddescription.para: Values can be: "deduplicate", "partial-update", "aggregation", "first-row". Default value is "deduplicate".

briefdescription.para: "sort-engine" - Specify the sort engine for table with primary key.

detaileddescription.para: Values can be: "min-heap", "loser-tree". Default value is "loser-tree".

briefdescription.para: "ignore-delete" - Whether to ignore delete records. Default value is "false".
"first-row.ignore-delete" deprecated as a fallback for IGNORE_DELETE.
"deduplicate.ignore-delete" deprecated as a fallback for IGNORE_DELETE.
"partial-update.ignore-delete" deprecated as a fallback for IGNORE_DELETE.
"fields.default-aggregate-function" - Default aggregate function of all fields for partial-update and aggregate merge function.
"deletion-vectors.enabled" - Whether to enable deletion vectors mode.

detaileddescription.para:
In this mode, index files containing deletion vectors are generated when data is written, which marks the data for deletion. During read operations, by applying these index files, merging can be avoided. Default value is false.
On a data-evolution table (DATA_EVOLUTION_ENABLED), Paimon C++ reads deletion vectors but does not write them: the deletes have to be issued by another engine, and such a table is never compacted.

briefdescription.para: "deletion-vector.index-file.target-size" - The target size of deletion vector index file.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 2MB.

briefdescription.para: "deletion-vectors.bitmap64" - Enable 64 bit bitmap implementation.

detaileddescription.para:
Note that only 64 bit bitmap implementation is compatible with Iceberg. Default value is "false".
: bitmap64 dv is not supported.

briefdescription.para: "changelog-producer" - Whether to double write to a changelog file.

detaileddescription.para: This changelog file keeps the details of data changes, it can be read directly during stream reads. This can be applied to tables with primary keys. Values can be "none", "input", "lookup", "full-compaction". Default value is "none".

briefdescription.para: "changelog-producer.row-deduplicate" - Whether to generate update-before and update-after changelog records when the row has not changed.

detaileddescription.para: This option is only valid for "lookup" or "full-compaction" changelog producers. Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "changelog-producer.row-deduplicate-ignore-fields" - Comma-separated fields to ignore when comparing rows for changelog deduplication.

detaileddescription.para: This option is only valid when "changelog-producer.row-deduplicate" is "true".

briefdescription.para: "changelog-file.prefix" - Specify the file name prefix of changelog files.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "changelog-".

briefdescription.para: "changelog-file.format" - Specify the file format of changelog files. No default value.
"changelog-file.compression" - Specify the compression of changelog files.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "force-lookup" - Whether to force the use of lookup for compaction.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "partial-update.remove-record-on-delete" - Whether to remove the whole row in partial-update engine when records are received.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "partial-update.remove-record-on-sequence-group" - When records of the given sequence groups are received, remove the whole row.
"scan.fallback-branch" - When a batch job queries from a table, if a partition does not exist in the current branch, the reader will try to get this partition from this fallback branch.
"branch" - Specify branch name. Default value is "main".
"file-index.read.enabled" - Whether enabled read file index. Default value is "true".
"file-index.in-manifest-threshold" - The threshold to store file index bytes in the manifest.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 500B.

briefdescription.para: "data-file.external-paths" - The external paths where the data of this table will be written, multiple elements separated by commas.
"data-file.external-paths.strategy" - The strategy of selecting an external path when writing data.

detaileddescription.para: Values can be: "none", "specific-fs", "round-robin". Default value is "none".

briefdescription.para: "data-file.prefix" - Specify the file name prefix of data files. Default value is "data-".
"index-file-in-data-file-dir" - Whether index file in data file directory.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "row-tracking.enabled" - Whether enable unique row id for append table.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "row-tracking.partition-group-on-commit" - When row-tracking is enabled, whether to group new file metas by partition before commit, so that assigned row IDs are contiguous within each partition.

detaileddescription.para: This is useful if you want to build global indices on this table. Default value is "true".

briefdescription.para: "data-evolution.enabled" - Whether enable data evolution for row tracking table.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "partition.legacy-name" - The legacy partition name is using ToString for all types.

detaileddescription.para: If false, using casting to string for all types. Default value is "true".

briefdescription.para: "map.storage-layout" - Suffix for per-column MAP storage layout configuration.

detaileddescription.para: Used as fields.<column>.map.storage-layout. Values: "default" (standard KV arrays) or "shared-shredding" (columnar shredding with column reuse). Default is "default". If set "shared-shredding", the column must be of type MAP<STRING, T>. Each column must be configured individually. For example, to enable shared-shredding layout for two columns "metrics" and "tags": fields.metrics.map.storage-layout = shared-shredding fields.tags.map.storage-layout = shared-shredding

briefdescription.para: "map.shared-shredding.max-columns" - Suffix for per-column upper bound K_max configuration.

detaileddescription.para: Used as fields.<column>.map.shared-shredding.max-columns. Only effective when map.storage-layout = shared-shredding. Rows with more fields than K_max spill to __overflow. Default value is 256. Each column can have its own max-columns setting.

briefdescription.para: "map.shared-shredding.column-placement-policy" - Suffix for per-column shared-shredding physical column placement policy.

detaileddescription.para: Used as fields.<column>.map.shared-shredding.column-placement-policy. Values: "plain", "sequential" and "lru". Default value is "lru". Only effective when map.storage-layout = shared-shredding.

briefdescription.para: "variant.shreddingSchema" - The Variant shredding schema for writing: a ROW type JSON whose fields map variant column names to their shredding types.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "parquet.variant.shreddingSchema" - Fallback key of "variant.shreddingSchema".
"variant.inferShreddingSchema" - Whether to automatically infer the shredding schema when writing Variant columns.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "variant.shredding.inferenceMode" - "per-file" or "adaptive". Default is "per-file".
"variant.shredding.maxSchemaWidth" - Maximum number of shredded fields allowed in an inferred schema.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 300.

briefdescription.para: "variant.shredding.maxSchemaDepth" - Maximum traversal depth in Variant values during schema inference.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 50.

briefdescription.para: "variant.shredding.minFieldCardinalityRatio" - Minimum fraction of rows that must contain a field for it to be shredded.

detaileddescription.para: Fields below this threshold stay in the un-shredded Variant binary. Default value is 0.1.

briefdescription.para: "variant.shredding.maxInferBufferRow" - Maximum number of rows to buffer for schema inference.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 4096.

briefdescription.para: "variant.shredding.adaptive.maxInferBufferRow" - Maximum prefix rows sampled after the first file in an adaptive session.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 256.

briefdescription.para: "variant.shredding.adaptive.retentionRatio" - Minimum combined ratio for retaining a previously selected path.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 0.05.

briefdescription.para: "blob-as-descriptor" - Read blob field using blob descriptor rather than blob bytes.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "blob-field" - Specifies column names that should be stored as blob type.

detaileddescription.para: This is used when you want to treat a BYTES column as a BLOB. Fields listed in blob-descriptor-field or blob-view-field are also treated as BLOB fields. Comma-separated field names. Multiple blob fields are supported. No default value.

briefdescription.para: "blob-descriptor-field" - Comma-separated field names to treat as BLOB fields and store as serialized BlobDescriptor bytes inline in data files.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "blob.stored-descriptor-fields" deprecated as a fallback for BLOB_DESCRIPTOR_FIELD.
"blob-view-field" - Comma-separated field names to treat as BLOB fields and store as serialized BlobViewStruct bytes inline in data files and resolve from upstream tables at read time.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "blob-view.resolve.enabled" - Whether to resolve blob-view-field values from upstream tables at read time.

detaileddescription.para: Set to false to preserve serialized BlobViewStruct bytes when forwarding blob view values to another blob-view table. Default value is "true".

briefdescription.para: "blob-view-upstream-warehouse" - Since the catalog capabilities are partially missing, when Blob View is enabled, cpp paimon cannot automatically obtain the upstream table warehouse path and requires manual configuration by the user.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "blob-write-null-on-missing-file" - Whether to write NULL for a descriptor BLOB value when the referenced file does not exist at write time.

detaileddescription.para: When false, a missing file is treated like any other fetch failure, following "blob-write-null-on-fetch-failure". Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "blob-write-null-on-fetch-failure" - Whether to write NULL for a descriptor BLOB value when the referenced data cannot be fetched at write time (e.g.

detaileddescription.para: invalid descriptor or invalid offset). A missing file is handled by "blob-write-null-on-missing-file" when that option is enabled. When false, the write fails when the descriptor is read. Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "global-index.enabled" - Whether to enable global index for scan. Default value is "true".
"global-index.thread-num" - The maximum number of concurrent scanner for global index.

detaileddescription.para: No default value. By default is the number of processors available to the machine.

briefdescription.para: "global-index.external-path" - Global index root directory, if not set, the global index files will be stored under the index directory.
"pk-btree.index.columns" - Comma-separated columns indexed by primary-key BTree indexes.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "pk-bitmap.index.columns" - Comma-separated columns indexed by primary-key Bitmap indexes.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "pk-vector.index.columns" - Comma-separated VECTOR columns indexed by primary-key vector indexes.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "pk-full-text.index.columns" - Comma-separated character columns indexed by primary-key full-text indexes.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "aggregation.remove-record-on-delete" - Whether to remove the whole row in aggregation engine when delete records are received.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "table-read.sequence-number.enabled" - Whether to include the _SEQUENCE_NUMBER field when reading the audit_log or binlog system tables.

detaileddescription.para: This is only valid for primary key tables. Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "key-value.sequence_number.enabled" - Whether to include the _SEQUENCE_NUMBER field when reading key-value data.

detaileddescription.para: This is an internal option used by AuditLogTable and BinlogTable when table-read.sequence-number.enabled is set to true. Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "scan.timestamp-millis" - Optional timestamp used in case of "from-timestamp" scan mode.

detaileddescription.para: For batch sources, produces the latest snapshot earlier than or equal to the timestamp. For streaming sources, starts from the first snapshot at or after the timestamp. "scan.timestamp" can be used as an alternative string input for the same mode.

briefdescription.para: "realtime.enabled" - Whether real-time write, commit, and read operations are enabled.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "realtime.read-view-ttl" - Lifetime of a real-time memory view pinned by scan planning before reader creation.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is "5 min".

briefdescription.para: "realtime.store.stats-mode" - Statistics collected by the default real-time store.

detaileddescription.para: Supported values are "none" and "full". Default value is "none".

briefdescription.para: "scan.timestamp" - Optional timestamp string used in case of "from-timestamp" scan mode, as an alternative to "scan.timestamp-millis".

detaileddescription.para: It will be automatically converted to timestamp in unix milliseconds, using local time zone. Supported formats: yyyy-MM-dd, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss, yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.SSS.

briefdescription.para: "scan.tag-name" - Optional tag name used in case of "from-snapshot" scan mode.
"write-only" - If set to "true", compactions and snapshot expiration will be skipped.

detaileddescription.para: This option is used along with dedicated compact jobs. Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "bucket-append-ordered" - Whether append writes in fixed bucket mode are ordered.

detaileddescription.para: This option is used by commit conflict checks. Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "write.sequence-number-init-mode" - Specify how to initialize the next sequence number for primary key table writers.

detaileddescription.para: Values can be: "scan", "snapshot". Default value is "scan".

briefdescription.para: "compaction.min.file-num" - For file set [f_0,...,f_N], the minimum file number to trigger a compaction for append-only table.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 5.

briefdescription.para: "compaction.force-rewrite-all-files" - Whether to force pick all files for a full compaction.

detaileddescription.para: Usually seen in a compaction task to external paths. Default value is "false".

briefdescription.para: "compaction.optimization-interval" - Implying how often to perform an optimization compaction, this configuration is used to ensure the query timeliness of the read-optimized system table.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "compaction.total-size-threshold" - When total size is smaller than this threshold, force a full compaction.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "compaction.incremental-size-threshold" - When incremental size is bigger than this threshold, force a full compaction.

detaileddescription.para: No default value.

briefdescription.para: "compaction.offpeak.start.hour" - The start of off-peak hours, expressed as an integer between 0 and 23, inclusive.

detaileddescription.para: Set to -1 to disable off-peak. Default is -1.

briefdescription.para: "compaction.offpeak.end.hour" - The end of off-peak hours, expressed as an integer between 0 and 23, exclusive.

detaileddescription.para: Set to -1 to disable off-peak. Default is -1.

briefdescription.para: "compaction.offpeak-ratio" - Allows you to set a different (by default, more aggressive) percentage ratio for determining whether larger sorted run's size are included in compactions during off-peak hours.

detaileddescription.para: Works in the same way as compaction.size-ratio. Only applies if offpeak.start.hour and offpeak.end.hour are also enabled. For instance, if your cluster experiences low pressure between 2 AM and 6 PM , you can configure compaction.offpeak.start.hour=2 and compaction.offpeak.end.hour=18 to define this period as off-peak hours. During these hours, you can increase the off-peak compaction ratio (e.g. compaction.offpeak-ratio=20) to enable more aggressive data compaction. Default is 0.

briefdescription.para: "lookup.cache.bloom.filter.enabled" - Whether to enable the bloom filter for lookup cache.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is true.

briefdescription.para: "lookup.cache.bloom.filter.fpp" - Define the default false positive probability for lookup cache bloom filters.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 0.05.

briefdescription.para: "lookup.remote-file.enabled" - Whether to enable the remote file for lookup.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is false.

briefdescription.para: "lookup.remote-file.level-threshold" - Level threshold of lookup to generate remote lookup files.

detaileddescription.para: Level files below this threshold will not generate remote lookup files. Default value is INT32_MIN.

briefdescription.para: "lookup.cache-spill-compression" - Spill compression for lookup cache, currently zstd, none, lz4 are supported.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is zstd. Noted that java paimon also supports lzo which paimon-cpp does not support for now.

briefdescription.para: "cache-page-size" - Memory page size for caching. Default value is 64 kb.

"file.format.per.level" - Define different file format for different level, you can add the conf like this: 'file.format.per.level' = '0:avro,3:parquet', if the file format for level is not provided, the default format which set by FILE_FORMAT will be used.
"file.compression.per.level" - Define different compression policies for different level, you can add the conf like this: 'file.compression.per.level' = '0:lz4,1:zstd'.

detaileddescription.para: If a level is not configured, the default compression set by FILE_COMPRESSION will be used.

briefdescription.para: "lookup.cache-max-memory-size" - Max memory size for lookup cache. Default value is 256 mb.
"lookup.cache.high-priority-pool-ratio" - The fraction of cache memory that is reserved for high-priority data like index, filter.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is 0.25.

briefdescription.para: "bucket-function.type" - The bucket function type for paimon bucket.

detaileddescription.para: Values can be: "default", "mod", "hive". Default value is "default".

briefdescription.para: "lookup.cache-file-retention" - The cached files retention time for lookup.

detaileddescription.para: After the file expires, if there is a need for access, it will be re-read from the DFS to build an index on the local disk. Default value is 1 hour.

briefdescription.para: "lookup.cache-max-disk-size" - Max disk size for lookup cache, you can use this option to limit the use of local disks.

detaileddescription.para: Default value is unlimited (INT64_MAX).

briefdescription.para: Configuration options and constants for Paimon table operations.

detaileddescription.para: The Options struct contains static string constants that define configuration keys used throughout the Paimon system.
